messages: jess: Quick FYI — found a broken anchor + missing frontmatter on /guides/model-onboarding.md. The link from 'Model registry' goes to a 404. Anyone own this page? .docs-bot: Automated check: 404 detected at /guides/model-onboarding.md#model-registry. Created issue #DOCS-4567. lina: that's in the guides space — @cory any recent edits there? cory: not me. I can take a look in ~30m. Is it an anchor id mismatch or a renamed heading? jess: Looks like the H2 was changed from 'Model registry' -> 'Registry' during the last cleanup, so the anchor id changed. Quick fix options: add an explicit HTML anchor, or add frontmatter aliases/redirects. Prefer frontmatter redirect so old links keep working. samir: agreed. Frontmatter aliases are fine. Example: ``` --- title: "Model onboarding" aliases: - "/guides/model-onboarding#model-registry" redirect_from: - "/guides/old-model-registry" --- ``` This keeps both anchor and old page links intact. cory: i'll open a tiny PR now: `docs: add alias + redirect for model-registry anchor` and assign to @lina for review. .deploy-bot: Build started for PR #5678 — running link-checker. .deploy-bot: Build failed: broken-link-checker found 1 issue in /guides/model-onboarding.md (PR #5678). Logs: https://ci.internal/redwood/5678 lina: Reviewing the PR now — thanks @cory. If link-checker complains after adding aliases, we can also add an HTML anchor like `` right above the heading as fallback. :thumbsup: cory: noted. I'll push the fallback if CI still fails. ETA for merge ~ 20m.
